missions.title: Inter-stage soft-clipper — BITE grown into the cascade (TRY IT)
missions.rationale: Resonances push into each other: a soft-knee between stages generates harmonics positioned by the upstream peak, carved by the downstream anatomy. Feed-forward cascade means no implicit loop — DF2T survives, no ZDF needed. This is what the reserved BITE knob was always supposed to become.

design.drive_0_contract: drive == 0.0 must be BIT-EXACT to the current linear cascade (branch on a bool, not a polynomial that approximates identity).
design.knee: reuse the engine's saturate() soft-knee shape per inter-stage junction, pre-scaled by drive; do NOT clip inside a biquad's own feedback, only BETWEEN stages
design.placement: after stage k output, before stage k+1 input, k = 0..4 (five junctions); post-cascade biteDriveBlock stays as-is for now
design.gain_staging: junction drive must be ramped on the same glide as slam_drive (delta per control block) so motion doesn't zipper the nonlinearity
design.aliasing: voice the drive range conservative (soft knee, low ceiling) — harmonics fold above 19531 Hz; heavy drive is out of scope until an HD island exists

missions.title: HD island option — 78125 Hz (exactly 2x the unit), wired into the plugin, default OFF
missions.rationale: Opens Nyquist to 39 kHz for air without abandoning the clock: same geometry, re-derived words. NOT Gemini's 'kill the island' — the unit survives as the unit. Successor precedent exists (X3 per-rate tables in the vault).

design.rederivation_law: decode each stage via stage_law::geometry_from_words -> re-encode at fs2=78125: pole/zero ANGLE from the same Hz (angle2 = 2*pi*hz/fs2); RADIUS preserves bandwidth in Hz: r2 = r^(39062.5/78125) = sqrt(r); SCALE unchanged. Real pairs go through words_from_geometry (never approximate them).
design.where: on cartridge load when the engine is prepared at 78125 — the stored body240 bytes NEVER change on disk; HD is a decode-time view
design.plugin_wiring: island rate becomes selectable {39062.5, 78125}; hidden APVTS bool 'hdMode' default false (NOT on the V1 face — diagnostics/config only). Island latency and buffer sizing already parameterized by rate in prepare().
design.warning: AGC table: active_agc_table() sqrt-law triggers only >65k — 78125 crosses it; verify the leveller feel is preserved or compensate (this is the likely gotcha).

missions.rationale: The resampler is the only stage between the verified engine and the listener that has never been measured. Cheap, and it either clears the 'dark' question or finds real loss.
